no_nano_gauntlet.title: Remove Nano Gauntlet (Iron Man Suit Enabled)

nano_gauntlet.title: Nano Gauntlet Skin
nano_gauntlet.description: Unlock with Vibranium Flux Capacitor in mainhand, then right click.

netherite_gauntlet.title: Netherite Gauntlet
netherite_gauntlet.description: Unlock with netherite ingot, then right click.

soul_netherite_gauntlet.title: Soul Infused Netherite Gauntlet
soul_netherite_gauntlet.description: Unlock with soul infused netherite ingot, then right click.

normal_gauntlet.title: Return to Original Gauntlet
normal_gauntlet.description: Removes the applied skin, press keybind.
commands: execute if entity @s[tag=netherite_gauntlet] run give @s netherite_ingot
execute if entity @s[tag=nano_gauntlet] run give @s palladium:vibranium_flux_capacitor
execute if entity @s[tag=fantastic_four_skin] run give @s shears
execute if entity @s[tag=soul_netherite_gauntlet] run give @s infinity:soul_infused_netherite_ingot
